name: Battleforged Artificer (CR 7)
body:
BATTLEFORGED ARTIFICER
CR 7

The metal-and-wood figure straightens, their blue eyes glowing beneath the hood of their cloak.

XP 3,200
Battleforged artificer (battleforged artificer) 8
True Neutral construct
Init +1; Senses Perception +10

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 11, flat-footed 15 (+1 Dex, +4 armor, +1 natural)
hp 53 (8d6+16)
Fort +4, Ref +5, Will +9
Defensive Abilities living construct; DR 1/-

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee slam +5 (1d4-1)
Ranged +1 light crossbow +8 (1d8+1/19-20)
Special Attacks charged ray (see feat)
Artificer Spells Prepared (CL 8; concentration +11)

3rd–greater magic weapon, recharge, wall of mist
2nd–blur, bull’s strength, heat metal, repair moderate damage, thunderous weapon
1st–comprehend languages, incendiary runes, repair light damage x2, weaponwand
Cantrips-amanuensis, detect magic, light, read magic, resistance

STATISTICS

Str 8, Dex 13, Con 14, Int 16, Wis 16, Cha 8
Base Atk +6; CMB +5; CMD 16
Feats Adamantine Body, Charged Ray, Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Craft Wand, Extend Spell, Scribe Scroll, Skill Focus (Use Magic Device), Wall Maker
Skills Appraise +10, Craft (woodwork) +12, Disable Device +14, Knowledge (arcana) +14, Knowledge (engineering) +12, Knowledge (planes) +10, Perception +10 (+14 to locate traps), Spellcraft +14, Use Magic Device +13 (+17 to activate identified items)
Languages Forge-language, Common, Draconic, Dwarven
SQ artifact knack, assurance (Craft), bonus metamagic feat, craft weapon familiar (+1 light crossbow grants +2 Reflex), expert crafter, infuse self, instilled trinket usage, magical artisan, metamagic spell trigger, repairing spell, research breakthrough x3, trapfinding
Combat Gear oil of repair light damage x3, scroll of displacement, scroll of fireball, scroll of fly, scroll of invisibility, wand of cure light wounds (15 charges), wand of magic missile (50 charges), wand of shield (20 charges), wand of mass shield (8 charges) intelligent +1 light crossbow with 20 bolts and a wand armature (currently the wand of magic missile), +2 enhancement bonus to inherent armor, amulet of natural armor +1, spellbook (0th-all; 1st-arcane pocket, comprehend languages, dancing lantern, lesser heroism, incendiary runes, pocket library, repair light damage, shock shield, spell storing item, weaponwand; 2nd-barkskin, blur, bull’s strength, heat metal, repair moderate damage, thunderous weapon; 3rd-greater magic weapon, lesser recharge, repair serious damage, wall of mist), 48 gp

Breath of Life: The Artificer, © 2026, Orphaned Bookworm Productions, LLC; Authors: Connor Bates and Paulo César Viola Da Silva Maia.
